weapon.d: If unit initiates combat or is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit, unit deals +X damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's attacks by 50% of X during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials; X = highest total bonuses among unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit).

b.d: Foes with Range = 1 cannot move through spaces adjacent to unit, and foes with Range = 2 cannot move through spaces within 2 spaces of unit. (Does not affect foes with Pass skills.) Inflicts Atk/Def-2 on foe during combat. Restores 3 HP to unit after combat.

c.d: At start of turn, if unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Def+3 to unit for 1 turn.
